home.hero.line2: We start where your child got stuck
home.honesty.title: What we do not promise
home.honesty.text: An honest conversation first, money second. Fewer disappointments that way — for you and for us.
home.honesty.item1: No promised grades or “results in a month”: we look at the level first.
home.honesty.item2: No prices on the site that the school has not confirmed.
home.honesty.item3: No testimonials or teacher details published without permission.
home.hero.title: Maths, English and Hebrew for school students in Israel
home.hero.subtitle: A free 30-minute meeting: we see what your child can already do and where they stall, then say honestly whether lessons are needed and which.
home.hero.online: Online. Teachers work in Hebrew, Russian or English — you choose.
home.find.title: Find lessons
home.unsure.title: Not sure what to choose?
home.unsure.text: You don't have to. We check the level in the meeting and suggest the option ourselves.
home.diagnostic.title: How the assessment works
home.diagnostic.step1.title: Request
home.diagnostic.step1.text: A two-minute form: subject, grade and what worries you.
home.diagnostic.step2.title: Meeting
home.diagnostic.step2.text: 30 minutes online with a teacher. We see what your child knows and where they stall.
home.diagnostic.step3.title: Recommendation
home.diagnostic.step3.text: We tell you what we found and suggest a plan. Whether to start is your call.
home.formats.title: Lesson formats
home.formats.group.title: Group
home.formats.group.text: Small groups at the same level. A good fit for steady work on the school curriculum.
home.formats.individual.title: One to one
home.formats.individual.text: Alone with a teacher. A good fit for closing gaps or preparing for bagrut.
home.value.title: What your family gets
home.value.item1: A clear picture of what your child already knows and what needs work.
home.value.item2: Lessons in the language your child is most comfortable with.
home.value.item3: Clear feedback after lessons, not “everything's fine”.

home.teachers.text: Who runs the lessons and which subjects they teach.
home.faq.title: Frequent questions
home.materials.title: Materials
home.materials.text: Workbooks and task sets can be bought on their own — you do not have to take lessons.
home.final.title: Start with a free meeting
home.final.text: You get a recommendation and decide for yourself. Nobody will chase you with phone calls.
